reapack.name: TS_360LinkFollow.lua
reapack.desc: TS_360LinkFollow - SSL 360 Link follows track visibility (UF8 / UC1)

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: Hidden tracks have SSL 360 Link removed; showing them inserts a fresh instance in the same slot. (Taking it offline kept the plugin's saved identity, which tracks made from the same template share, and SSL 360 ignored the copy that came back.) 360 Links are put back one at a time: SSL 360 drops connections when many start at once. Each one is checked against SSL 360's log and replaced again if its strip has not registered within a few seconds. New: TS_360LinkFollow_Refresh replaces every 360 Link in the project the same way -- for a session or template whose strips are missing.

reapack.name: TS_ChannelView.lua
reapack.desc: ChannelView -- docked channel strip: one editable control panel per plugin

version.author: Tim Shadgett (with Claude)
version.changelog: ReaEQ panels become a draggable curve editor. Track management in the track row and mixer: insert tracks and track templates, right-click track menu (rename, spacer, folders, colour), three-state folder button, drag headers to reorder. New Receives panel; Sends can create their destination track. New "stepped knob" control type. Fixes: half-gaps and divider line settings are remembered.

version.author: Tim Shadgett (with Claude)
version.changelog: Keyboard focus goes back to REAPER after a click or drag in ChannelView, so Space, navigation and your other shortcuts keep working (View > Return keyboard focus to REAPER; needs js_ReaScriptAPI or SWS).

version.author: Tim Shadgett (with Claude)
version.changelog: Optional track icons (View > Track icons, off by default): REAPER's track icons shown above each name button, in both views.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: Optional track icons (View > Track icons, off by default): REAPER's track icons shown above each name button, in both views.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: Live parameter names, per plugin or per control, for plugins that rename their own parameters (Softube Console 1, Flow). Knob labels too wide for their cell are abbreviated (Freq, Thresh, dropped vowels) instead of cut. "Show the input FX chain" opens the chain rather than the Add FX browser.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: Gain reduction for plugins that don't report it. Needs a TS_TrackProbe at each end of the track's FX chain (installed with ChannelView; the new Probes button in the header adds the pair). Tick "Measure gain reduction" on a plugin and the probes measure it, with its zero measured whenever playback stops. Measured reduction is pink, reported is amber. A whole-track GR bar beside the level meter. GR meters default to an 18 dB scale. "New track with FX chain" in every add-track menu. TCP: the channel panel follows the selection once open; toolbar gaps.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog:
MIDI sends and receives: a third mode beside Direct and Sidechain -- MIDI only, all channels, no audio. In the add menu, the right-click menu, and on each send's mode button, which cycles DIR, SC and MIDI (a MIDI socket on blue).
1.4.0 (never reached ReaPack -- the index build stopped on three dev files; it arrives together with this one): gain reduction for plugins that don't report it, measured by a TS_TrackProbe pair (the new Probes button adds one), with its zero measured whenever playback stops; measured reduction pink, reported amber; a whole-track GR bar; 18 dB meter scale; "New track with FX chain"; TCP follows the selection.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: Input/output meters per plugin: tick "Input/output meters" on any plugin and its panel gets a meter for what goes in, one for what comes out, and the change in level between them (output RMS minus input RMS). Measured by the track's TS_TrackProbe pair, like measured gain reduction. Every panel header also shows the plugin's wet % (REAPER's own wet/dry mix): dim at 100%, highlighted when it's anything else; click it for a slider.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: The ReaEQ panel gets input/output meters too: tick "Input/output meters" on ReaEQ and it gets the input meter hard left and the output hard right, with the EQ canvas between them at its usual width. 1.5.0 left them off that panel.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: Fixed: ReaEQ's wet % could show (and set) the wrong value after a band was added or removed -- it read whichever ReaEQ parameter had moved into the wet control's old place. The wet control is now looked up again whenever a plugin's parameter count changes.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: ReaEQ can no longer be set to measure gain reduction. An EQ has none: the probe was reading the curve's effect on the programme, which Track Analyser drew as a second measured trace bouncing several dB. The option is gone from ReaEQ's menu and Edit Parameters, and a saved layout that still has it is ignored -- ReaEQ is tapped for its levels only.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: Hardware styles: right-click a knob or fader > Style for Skirted, Pointer or Trim pot knobs and Console or Rail fader caps, in nine cap colours; the panel menu's Faceplate puts a panel on Charcoal, Gunmetal, Aluminium, Steel blue, Navy, Cream, Racing green or Oxblood, with a gentle texture (View > Faceplate texture). Saved with the plugin's layout. Gain-reduction trace: click a gain-reduction meter to open a trace of that plugin alone -- its output waveform, its input behind, its reduction from the top -- tempo-locked or in seconds, frozen when stopped. Needs TS_TrackProbe 1.5.0: reopen the project after updating. The wet slider's 100% button is gone.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: Web companion: ChannelView on a tablet. The selected track's panels, with your layouts, styles and faceplates, in a browser -- plus the transport, macro buttons, sends, the ReaEQ curve editor, gain-reduction traces, a half-height mixer and a session navigator. Served by REAPER's own web interface, with TS_ChannelView_Web.lua running alongside. Setup: see "On a tablet" in the README. The [+] add menu searches as you type, and plugin search is forgiving and ranked: "proq", "pq4" and "saturm" all find what you meant, best match first, recently used plugins nudged up.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: Web page: in the mixer, each fader now sits directly under its pan knob.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: The [+] menu's search results scroll instead of running off the bottom of the screen, and a menu opened low on the screen grows upward. The search dialog's folder/category/developer filter scrolls too. Auto-fill layout, Clear layout and Forget saved layout ask before they replace a saved layout. Combo boxes are readable on light faceplates (Aluminium, Cream). Web page: selecting the master track no longer risks stopping the bridge.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: A preset bar along the foot of every panel, on the desktop and the web page: REAPER's presets in a dropdown with previous and next beside it, and a + to save a preset, save one as the plugin's default, rename or delete one (VST2, VST3 and JS). View > Preset bar turns it off. The track Colour... dialog has a palette dropdown: REAPER 7.81's built-in palettes, your user palettes and the project's colours, as well as the old custom colours, plus a button for REAPER's own picker. Dropdowns are readable on light faceplates, and a preset name too long for its box shows in full on hover. A tablet in the header shows when the web companion is running, filled in while a page is connected. View > Start web companion with REAPER, and the TS_ChannelView_Web_Startup action, start it with REAPER. A new knob style, Round nose: a grey body whose short nose is the pointer, with the cap colour in its centre.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: The master's Sends panel is its hardware Outputs (level, mute, pre/post, which device channels, add and remove), on the desktop and the web page, and the master has no Receives panel. Its strip has a Mono switch where other tracks have record arm, and its fader and buttons line up with theirs. Collapsed mixer strips line up with full ones: the meter and fader over the same span, M, S and R stacked in the button rows, and a mini pan. The master strip collapses too, and a collapsed fader shows at rest. Collapse arrows point left, expand arrows right. CLAP plugins save presets (save, save as default, rename, delete). Web page: tap a mixer strip to select its track; double-tap a strip or its name button to collapse it; folders collapse and hide as in REAPER; master Outputs; the macro bar centres, wraps, takes spacers and drags to reorder; double-tap the fader panel to collapse it.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: New knob styles: Bar, Fluted, Bezel, Reverse bezel and Hi-fi; Silver and Stone cap colours; Stone, Cobalt and Amber faceplates, and a Brushed finish for any faceplate. Knob sizes (Small, Medium, Large) and small toggles; toggle buttons say the state's name, with state names of your own and lit colours. Dropdowns as a row or column of buttons. Sections (experimental): a divider can put the controls after it on an inset or a faceplate. View > Control spacing (default now 50 px, narrower panels). Plugins renamed in REAPER's FX chain show that name and keep their layout; rename from the panel menu. Enter commits every text box. The web page follows all of it. Existing layouts are unchanged.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: A background for any control (right-click > Background): an inset or a faceplate colour behind it, over its section's. Neighbours with the same background, side by side or stacked, join into one rounded shape, across a divider too; it always fills the control's column. Gaps and half-gaps can have one as well. Values under controls are smaller and sit just under the control. The web page draws the same shapes.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: Lock layout: a padlock at the left of each panel's foot. Locked, the plugin's layout takes no edits and keeps its arrangement however the panel is resized; too short, it scrolls up and down, the meters staying put. Meters can still be switched on and off while locked. The panel's foot is always shown now, for the padlock. Brushed finish for control backgrounds and sections. The web page follows both.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: Any colour for faceplates, backgrounds, sections, knob caps and button lights: [+] Custom colour opens the colour picker, with recent colours. The colour picker has an eyedropper that reads anywhere on screen (needs js_ReaScriptAPI), in every colour dialog, track colours included. Button faces for toggles and button rows: Lit lens, LED window, Backlit. Knobs print their values round the dial by default (Style > Scale: Values, 0-10 or None). LED ring knob style. Gold faceplate; White, Brown and Gold caps. Metallic finish for faceplates, backgrounds and sections. View > 3D effect (replaces Faceplate texture). View > Use mouse wheel on controls. Toggle mixer view action for a shortcut or toolbar. Layouts > Import / Export layouts to file. Sections are no longer experimental, and same-style neighbours join. TCP window: plugin delay (PDC) under meters, in its settings menu. Web page: all of the above, plus full screen and install as an app on Android. Restart the web companion script after updating. Fix: no more "InvisibleButton: Assertion failed" stop when the window is docked very short (mixer view).

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: Right-click any track fader (Channel panel, mixer, TCP window) for its style (Flat, Console, Rail) and colour, with the colour picker, eyedropper and recent colours; saved with the track. Acts on the selection when the track is part of it. Group looks: folder parents, VCA leaders, FX returns and a Default for every other track; a track's own choice wins, then its group's, then the Default. The web page shows the same looks. Restart the web companion script after updating.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: Parallel FX and FX containers: brackets over the panels, Route in series / parallel / parallel with MIDI merged, put in a new container, container menu (bypass, add into, unpack, remove, save as chain), drag into and out of containers. Parameter modulation from a control's menu, with marks on modulated controls. Save and delete FX chains. Edit REAPER's FX folders from the add-plugin menu. Collapsed plugins come in collapsed. Faders of any shape (up or across, length, half thickness) placed among the controls as merged cells; Slim fader style. XY pad and concentric knob. Copy and paste a control's style. Matte knob caps. Buttons show the plugin's own choice names. Edit parameters reorganised into a settings column. The web page has the same: restart the web companion script after updating.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: REAPER's oversampling from ChannelView: OS in a panel's foot for a plugin, a container's menu for everything in it, OS in the header bar for the whole chain; lit with the factor while it's on. Set a plugin offline from its menu (its panel turns steel blue). View > Strip width: the fader panel, mixer strips and track name buttons, 72 to 240 px; the meter and fader scale with it. Measured gain reduction and input/output meters now work on plugins inside FX containers, however deep. A plugin running in parallel isn't measured, and Edit parameters says so. A plugin with sidechain inputs in a container that doesn't pass 3/4 offers to widen it. The Probes button puts the first probe after an ARA plugin (Melodyne and the like), which REAPER keeps in the first slot. The web page has the same: restart the web companion script after updating.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: ReaComp gets a panel of its own, as ReaEQ does: a transfer curve to drag (threshold, knee, ratio), attack, release and pre-comp as an envelope, a live dot showing where the signal sits on the curve, the level history and gain reduction behind it, and the detector in a drawer. Needs TS_TrackProbe on the track for the history and the dot. Duplicate a plugin or a container from its menu. A Wet slider in every plugin's menu, at any panel width. The quick search in the add-plugin menu: Up and Down pick, Enter adds. The web page has the same: restart the web companion script after updating.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: Pages: a Page break in a plugin's layout splits its panel into tabs, each with a name and a colour stripe. Show when: a control can show only while another parameter is, isn't, is above, is below or is between given values -- a delay's sync switch swapping its note knob for its ms knob in one place. More than one layout per plugin, picked per instance from the panel menu (Layout): copy the one you have to a new one, or start empty. Background tint: the strip, the track name and the Channel panel can take a share of the track's colour, per group or per track; the TCP window can follow. While REAPER is busy on a long job, such as a plugin scan, ChannelView backs off rather than keep reading plugins through it. A gain-reduction trace says when its plugin is outside the probes. Fix: a trace could flicker while the web companion was running. The web page has the same: restart the web companion script after updating.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: Fix: Edit Parameters could stop ChannelView with an error when the selected track changed while it was open (nothing selected, or the project closed or switched). It now keeps working on the plugin it was opened for, follows it if it moves in the chain, and closes if it's deleted, putting back anything applied.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: Macros and modulators. Two new panels between the Channel panel and the plugins: up to 16 macros (knob, button, fader, dropdown, XY pad) and 8 modulators (LFO, audio follower, MIDI). Drag a source's handle onto any control to drive it; set the range or swing with handles on the control's ring or bar. They run in one small plugin, ChannelView Modulators, through REAPER's own parameter links, so every setting can be automated. The idea is Saxmand's FX Modulator Linking, with thanks (see the README for what was used and what wasn't). Automation lanes from any control's right-click menu, and removable. Track probes hidden from the plugin row and kept at the ends of the chain, with a header indicator, a Visualizer option and Remove. TCP window: track buttons that are always there, swipeable. Web companion: macros and modulators; the macro bar is now Actions. Restart the web companion after updating.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: Plugins removed from their developer in REAPER's FX browser are hidden from ChannelView's add-plugin menu and search too; one already on a track keeps its panel. Shell plugins such as Waves are matched to REAPER's developers, categories and folders build by build. TCP window toolbar: right-click ▸ Copy a REAPER toolbar. Icons are also found in the theme's own folder, and a toggle with an _off icon shows its _on partner while on.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: EQ and compressor layouts for any plugin: Layout ▸ New EQ layout… / New compressor layout…. An EQ's bands are mapped to its controls and their shapes learned from a hidden copy of the plugin; a compressor's threshold, ratio, attack, hold, release and the rest are mapped and read from the plugin's own values. The plugin's other controls sit beside the canvas. On the web companion too. A default layout per plugin (Make "<name>" the default); the plugin's own layout is now called Standard.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: Canvas layouts for any plugin: Layout ▸ New canvas layout ▸ EQ (with dynamic bands), Compressor, Multiband, Gate, Limiter, De-esser, Saturation, Delay, Reverb, Modulation or Envelope. Shapes, thresholds, reverb decay and saturation curves measured on a hidden copy of the plugin. ReaDelay and ReaVerbate set themselves up. Virtual controls, layouts that switch themselves, a default layout per plugin, custom value ranges for plugins that won't say. Tidier right-click and panel menus; settings in both places. Fixes: stepped knob drag, factory presets, VSL Synchron stall, the gain-reduction trace's timing. TS_TrackProbe 1.8.0.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: Fixes: an EQ layout whose band had its Q learned on one side only stopped ChannelView when the band was turned the other way; a ReaDelay tap turned up past 0 dB drew its dot off the canvas, out of reach (the canvas now makes room up to +6 dB).

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: Reopen projects after updating (new probe and Modulators plugin). MIDI learn bar: last touched parameter + last moved MIDI control (CC, note, program change, pitch bend), one click to link, REAPER's own learn. Modulators moved by macros and other modulators; button and dropdown macros switch LFO shape, sync and more. Header: one menu, web companion status strip with start/stop, red glow while the FX chain is bypassed. TS_TrackProbe 2.0.0 has no parameters (no more "last touched" hijack). Track-colour backgrounds tint the controls; TDR Slick EQ boosts and switched Q; smoother modulator trace; shorter tooltips.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: Action bars anywhere: drawers on any side of ChannelView, bars in their own windows (floating or docked), the TCP's toolbars and the web's Actions bar, all built in one Organise actions window, with nested menus, toolbar switches (tabs) and import / export. ChannelView's own icons (nearly 300), sharp at any size, matched to actions automatically, on the desktop and the web page. Bar sizes per bar. Virtual controls can run REAPER actions. Canvas curves drawn in one go (cleaner joins). Tidier code comments.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: Action bars: align buttons left, centre or right and top, centre or bottom; colour buttons (an underline, or coloured icons that fill when on), desktop and web; Add a PNG in the icon picker copies one into Data/toolbar_icons. Fixed: "exceeded maximum object attachment limit" when browsing PNG icons.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: Fixed: with ChannelView TCP running, REAPER's Insert FX actions did nothing after a track was selected in it. Selecting a track there now makes the tracks REAPER's context, as a click in REAPER's own track panel does (so Delete removes tracks too, as there).

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: The Trimmer: a first-in-the-chain plugin with VU meters, linkable trims, low and high cut over a spectrum, Auto trim from the items and Listen; added with one click from the header. Action bars: buttons that add a plugin or an FX chain (several picked at once), a colour style per button, and icons and colours on menu rows.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: Hardware looks: finishes (brushed, anodised, satin, tolex, leather, wood, crinkle, enamel, hammertone, checker plate...), soft and round corners, ten switch styles for toggles, seventeen knob recipes built from parts and a Knob look editor for your own, concentric knob recipe pairs, one light with View > Lighting and View > Shadows. Rack view: the plugins down a column in a window of its own, with its own layouts. Show or hide the macros, modulators, sends and receives. EQ canvases draw notch, band pass, tilt, flat top, sword and all pass bands and any slope. Vendor colours for plugin buttons. Fixes for measuring after a plugin that takes the track's channel count, the selected outline and Enabled/Disabled switches. Restart the web companion after updating.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: ChannelView Rack can start with REAPER (its own Run when REAPER starts). A toolbar in its own window shows its name, as a drawer does. Fixed: a toolbar window sized a little short showed nothing and had no right-click menu.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: Freeze: Freeze track, Freeze up to the selected plugin and Unfreeze from the header's snowflake, frozen plugins shown where they were; the probes and ChannelView Modulators are never frozen. Rack: Collapse all, and chevrons that point up to fold. A track left with one probe gets the other back. EQ canvases draw what learning measured beyond each band's formula (console types' tails, shelves' bumps), and a plugin-wide Model switch (TDR Slick EQ) is learned at every setting. Learn an EQ layout again to have these.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: Grooved knobs (Console) have their grooves cut out of the edge. Knobs are no longer tilted (Console, Wing; the Knob look window's Tilt is gone). Printed skirt ticks turn with the knob. The Numbered skirt is gone (drawn as a printed one); Numbered dial is now Dial.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: View > Float plugins without controls (closed again at the next track change unless pinned). Rack: a padlock locks it to a track. Style > Value arc on any knob. Style > Use this look for new knobs / buttons. The plugin's own colours in every colour menu, and Faceplate > Match the plugin. Raised dropdowns. A plugin button's own vendor look. FX chain buttons can replace the plugins, or ask (the probes, Trimmer and Modulators stay). An EQ learn that measured noise is caught; learning follows a latency change.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: Pill rockers take a colour of their own (the cap's). A bar in its own window can have its own background. A toolbar menu can have large items, as the header's menus. EQ learning: bands whose shape switch just says Shelf are learned on their own (learn such an EQ again).

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: Rack: a plugin takes the fewest rows that fit across the column, never fewer than its tallest control needs (a layout ChannelView shows too, running down then across, keeps the rows it fills there). On a panel under three rows the gain-reduction meter lies across the top. The rack has its own Control flow.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: ChannelView now comes in two parts: ChannelView (free, here) and ChannelView Pro, an add-on from its own ReaPack link. Pro has grid layouts and the grid editor, the rack, the web companion, canvases and the hardware looks; layouts made with it still work without it, drawn plainly. The Control flow menu is gone: controls flow down then across (in Pro's rack, across then down). See the CHANGELOG.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: Bypass modulation: a power button for each modulator and one for all, and an action for a key or toolbar button. Smart folders list their plugins, and a search can be saved as one. Large submenus (was Large items) draws a menu's submenus as the bar's buttons. The probes leave a sidechain alone: their spare inputs start unplugged, and a plugin routed onto the taps' channels on purpose keeps its routing. With Pro, ReaGate and ReaLimit start with canvases. See the CHANGELOG.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: Organise actions: Import shows its list of bars again after you pick a file (3.1.0 opened the file picker and then nothing).

reapack.name: TS_TrackAnalyser.lua
reapack.desc: Track Analyser -- measured response over the spectrum, over dynamics

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: First public release. A docked two-panel display of what your processing does to the selected track, measured from the audio by a TS_TrackProbe at each end of the FX chain: the measured EQ response over the spectrum, a before/after waveform with gain reduction over it, and a masking (Collisions) view against another track. The waveform window can be set in beats at the project tempo and locked to the beat, like a triggered scope. New in this release: gain reduction for plugins ChannelView measures, one 500-a-second trace per compressor, and traces lined up with the waveform.

version.author: Tim Shadgett
version.changelog: 1.4.1 keeps Track Analyser in step with ChannelView; nothing in it changed. 1.4.0 never reached ReaPack, so this is the first public release. A docked two-panel display of what your processing does to the selected track, measured from the audio by a TS_TrackProbe at each end of the FX chain: the measured EQ response over the spectrum, a before/after waveform with gain reduction over it, and a masking (Collisions) view against another track. The waveform window can be set in beats at the project tempo and locked to the beat, like a triggered scope. New in this release: gain reduction for plugins ChannelView measures, one 500-a-second trace per compressor, and traces lined up with the waveform.

version.author: Tim Shadgett (with Claude) -- fork of JKK_Visualizer by Junki Kim
version.changelog: First release in TS-ReaScripts. A fork of JKK_Visualizer by Junki Kim: LUFS, goniometer, Symbiote, scope, spectrum and spectrogram as before, plus a Dynamics module (short-term LUFS against PSR) with loudness and genre targets, a per-track spectrum overlay from TS_TrackProbe, and a Hue/Tint colour system shared with ChannelView and Track Analyser.
